title: When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.18142v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. translated_title: 当复制难以被超越：临床评估预测中的一项负面结果
translated_abstract: 我们报告了在次日临床评估预测任务中的一项负面结果：所评估的模型相比强大的持续性基线并未表现出一致的优势。临床医生可以查看前一天的问卷答案，这是文档持续性的一种合理来源。在29,715个ICU日对上使用患者不相交的数据划分来预测45个条目时，一个基于生理信息的门控模型相比单行临床规则将条目宏F1提高了+0.0019 [+0.0006, +0.0031]，但准确率有所下降。当生理数据窗口结束于前一份表格的参考时间时（+0.0001 [-0.0006, +0.0008]），或当评分排除68.5%源自父级答案的单元格时，宏F1优势均无法确立；而将这两项变化结合时则出现了小幅劣势。三个模型家族的四个检查点均表现不如持续性基线，其中一个经过微调的模型与持续性基线仅在两个单元格上存在差异。分类式读出使变更单元格的准确率提高了八倍，但仅基于状态的
tldr: 该研究是一项负面结果，表明在预测次日临床评估时，各类模型相比简单复制前一天答案的持续性基线并无一致优势。
en_tdlr: This study reports a negative result showing that evaluated models offer no consistent advantage over simple persistence-based baselines that copy the previous day's answers when forecasting next-day clinical assessments.
